title: Banana Bread
description: A simple, moist banana loaf — uses up overripe bananas.

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Preheat oven to 175°C. Grease a standard 23x13cm loaf pan.

steps.title: Mash bananas
steps.body: Mash {{ bananas }} in a large bowl until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.body: Stir in melted {{ butter }}, {{ sugar }}, {{ egg }}, and {{ vanilla }}.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.body: Sprinkle {{ soda.name }} and {{ salt.name }} over the batter, then fold in {{ flour }} until just combined. Stir in {{ walnuts }}.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour into the prepared pan and bake for @timer(60m) until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Let cool in the pan for @timer(20m) before turning out onto a rack.
